kind: offline auditor and synthetic test preparation correction, no model/API calls
finding: First replay counted sum(content UTF8 bytes)+1024. Existing production gateway counts len(json.dumps(messages, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'))+1024, including escaped newlines, quotes and framing. The first calculation undercounted the16 observed inputs; all still fit under the correct guard. A separate authored quote-heavy control can exceed32768 although the first calculation says it fits.
correction: Replay uses the exact existing gateway serialization. No production input/reserve/output bound is raised, no source is truncated and no request is sent.
